info.about: Silent Hill: Shattered Memories is a 2009 survival horror game developed by Climax Studios and published by Konami. It was released in December for the Wii and ported to the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable platforms in January 2010.
info.trivia: A re-imagining of the first game built around a psychological profile of the player.
info.why: The Wii version is common; the PSP and PS2 versions were printed in far smaller numbers, so this one prices well above it.
